newsitem.title: UK: Exxon Italy hitch cuts gas oil run-trade.
newsitem.headline: Exxon Italy hitch cuts gas oil run-trade.

text.p: Exxon's refinery in Sicily has lowered gas oil output because of a technical fault at a topping plant, traders said on Thursday.

The problem at the Augusta installation resulted in Esso entering the Mediterranean distillate market and buying a 17,000 to 18,000 tonne cargo of EN590 quality gas oil on Wednesday to meet its requirements, they said.

The fault has affected the larger of the refinery's two topping plants for the past week and was expected to last two or three more days. The refinery has a distillation capacity of 188,000 barrels a day.
"It's not a major problem," one trader said.
Officials at Esso Italiana declined to comment.
